theorems.name: Submission.ts_pwb_blowup_at_good_point
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (a : RectifiablePair n ℓ) (N K : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (x : Ambient n ℓ) (f : C_c(Ambient n ℓ, ℝ)) (Γ L : ℝ), MeasurableSet N → (μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) N ≠ ⊤ → IsCompact K → K ⊆ a.M ∩ N → x ∈ K → ContinuousWithinAt a.θ K x → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → (μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (N ∩ closedBall x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * ρ ^ n)) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ (mk a).weight.real (Kᶜ ∩ closedBall x r) / r ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ ((μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)).restrict N).real (Kᶜ ∩ closedBall x r) / r ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y in N, f (t⁻¹ • (y - x)) ∂μHE[n]) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 L) → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y, f (t⁻¹ • (y - x)) ∂(mk a).weight) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (a.θ x * L))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
